data.name: Abeen
data.gender_notes: Abeen is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Sister of the father or mother's sister. The name Abeen carries the meaning “Father's sister” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Abeen usually hope their child will grow to embody father's sister and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes love, support, and care from the family
data.etymology: Abeen belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Father's sister.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Abeen total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: عابين
in_arabic.meaning: عابين تعني من يغوص في عمق التفكير و التأمل
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم عابين مشتق من الجذر العربي (ع-ب-ن) الذي يحمل معاني الانغماس في التفكير العميق و التأمل. يستخدم هذا الاسم في الثقافة الإسلامية لوصف الشخص الذي يميل إلى التفكر و البحث في معاني الحياة و الأمور الروحية. وردت مشتقات هذا الجذر في القرآن الكريم في سياق التفكر و التأمل في خلق الله و آياته.

in_hindi.name: आबीन
in_hindi.meaning: आबीन का अर्थ है जो गहरी सोच और ध्यान में लीन होता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: आबीन नाम अरबी मूल (ع-ب-ن) से निकला है जिसका अर्थ है गहरी सोच और ध्यान में लीन होना। यह नाम इस्लामी संस्कृति में उस व्यक्ति के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है जो जीवन के अर्थ और आध्यात्मिक मामलों में विचार करने का शौक रखता है। अरबी मूल के व्युत्पन्न قرآن में विचार-विमर्श के संदर्भ में उल्लेखित हैं।

in_english.name: Abeen
in_english.meaning: Abeen means one who is engaged in deep thought and contemplation
in_english.long_meaning: The name Abeen is derived from the Arabic root (ع-ب-ن) which carries meanings related to being engaged in deep thought and contemplation. This name is used in Islamic culture to describe a person who tends to ponder and research the meanings of life and spiritual matters. Derivatives of this root are mentioned in the Quran in the context of reflection and contemplation on God's creation and signs.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Abeen" holds a significant cultural value in Islamic society as it is an Arabic name meaning 'sister of the father or mother's sister.' In traditional, extended families, this name holds greater importance as it emphasizes the idea of a large, closely-knit family unit where relationships are defined through complex and intricate familial connections. It emphasizes the value of family and the bonds between sisters, particularly those who share a familial connection through their fathers or mothers.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual context, the name "Abeen" holds a special significance as it represents the bond of sisterhood, which is celebrated in Islam. The teachings of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) emphasize the importance of positive relationships and love between siblings. According to a hadith, the Prophet said, "And the best of people are those who have the best manners and character." (Muslim) Sisters are encouraged to show love and kindness towards one another, to support and uplift each other, and to maintain strong bonds of sisterhood. As such, the name "Abeen" serves as a reminder of the spiritual importance of sisterhood and the virtues of love, kindness, and support among siblings.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Father's sister" symbolizes Sister of the father or mother's sister. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Abeen serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of father's sister.
